study: RSRS report replication, controlled differences and volatility sizing
source_target: Figures 25-26 and Table 5: right-skew RSRS with MA20 entry filter
primary_comparison: max_drawdown reduction with annualized return, Sharpe and turnover reported together
execution: decision at close t, trade at open t+1, mark at close t+1
standardization: previous M valid slopes excluding current; population standard deviation; strict full warmup
ma_filter: entry only; MA20[t] > MA20[t-2]; no forced exit on MA decline
selection_rule: no final-period winner replacement; report every registered candidate

source_compatible_supplement.basis: Source p22 explicitly permits partial early history; minimum observations, ddof and exact endpoints remain assumptions

limitations: The exact original Wind sample and minimum early warmup are unavailable
Price indices are research proxies, not executable securities
Source headline numbers are not directly comparable to the common-window study
No leverage, financing, dividends or live brokerage execution
